# National Geographic
> Authoritative journalism and visual storytelling about science, animals, history, travel, culture, and the natural world.

National Geographic publishes reported features, explainers, photography, and guides spanning wildlife, archaeology, environment, space, health, and destinations worldwide. Its site combines topical verticals, magazine-style storytelling, videos, newsletters, and subscription offerings.

## Main Sections
- [Latest Stories](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/latest-stories): Recent reporting and featured stories from across National Geographic coverage areas.
- [Animals](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals): Wildlife news, species profiles, conservation reporting, and animal behavior stories.
- [Environment](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment): Climate, ecosystems, conservation, pollution, and environmental change coverage.
- [History](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history): Archaeology, ancient civilizations, historical analysis, and cultural heritage reporting.
- [Science](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science): Space, Earth science, evolution, technology, and scientific discovery coverage.
- [Travel](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel): Destination features, travel ideas, practical advice, and cultural travel reporting.
- [Culture](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture): Stories on traditions, identity, food, language, and communities worldwide.
- [Photography](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/photography): Photo essays, visual storytelling, and work from National Geographic photographers.

## Animals
- [Animals](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals): Main animals hub for wildlife features, conservation, and species-focused reporting.
- [Animal News](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/topic/animal-news): Timely wildlife discoveries, behavior research, and conservation developments.
- [Mammals](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/mammals): Reporting and explainers focused on mammals around the world.
- [Birds](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/birds): Bird species coverage, migration stories, and avian science reporting.
- [Marine Life](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/topic/marine-life): Ocean species stories covering whales, sharks, reefs, and marine ecosystems.
- [Wildlife Watch](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/topic/wildlife-watch): Investigative reporting on wildlife crime, trade, and conservation enforcement.

## Environment
- [Environment](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment): Main environment hub for climate, biodiversity, and sustainability coverage.
- [Climate Change](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment/topic/climate-change): Reporting on warming, impacts, adaptation, and climate science.
- [Conservation](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment/topic/conservation): Stories on habitat protection, restoration, and biodiversity preservation.
- [Pollution](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment/topic/pollution): Coverage of plastics, air quality, toxins, and environmental contamination.
- [Freshwater](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment/topic/freshwater): Reporting on rivers, lakes, drought, and water resources.
- [Ocean](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/environment/topic/ocean): Stories about seas, coasts, marine ecosystems, and ocean change.

## Science
- [Science](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science): Main science hub covering discoveries across Earth, life, and space sciences.
- [Space](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/topic/space): Space exploration, astronomy, planets, and mission coverage.
- [Archaeology](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/topic/archaeology): Scientific reporting on excavations, ancient remains, and material culture.
- [Human Body](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/topic/human-body): Health and biology explainers about anatomy, disease, and physiology.
- [Earth Science](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/topic/earth-science): Geology, volcanoes, earthquakes, weather, and planetary processes.
- [Innovation](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/topic/innovation): Technology and research stories with scientific and societal impact.

## History
- [History](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history): Main history hub for archaeology, ancient worlds, and historical interpretation.
- [Archaeology](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/topic/archaeology): Historical and archaeological features on sites, artifacts, and discoveries.
- [Ancient Civilizations](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/topic/ancient-civilizations): Stories about early societies, empires, and cultural development.
- [U.S. History](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/topic/us-history): Reporting and explainers on American history and historical figures.
- [World War II](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/topic/world-war-ii): Features on events, people, and legacies of the war.
- [Holidays](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/history/topic/holidays): Background on global holidays, traditions, and seasonal observances.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel): Main travel hub for destination inspiration, advice, and cultural context.
- [Destinations](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/destinations): Regional and country destination guides and travel features.
- [Family Travel](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/topic/family-travel): Travel ideas and advice for trips with children and families.
- [Adventure Travel](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/topic/adventure): Outdoor trips, expeditions, and active travel experiences.
- [Food and Drink](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/topic/food-and-drink): Culinary travel stories, local dishes, and food-focused itineraries.
- [Travel Tips](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/travel/topic/travel-tips): Practical guidance for planning, packing, timing, and responsible travel.

## Culture
- [Culture](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture): Main culture hub for identity, traditions, arts, and social life.
- [Food](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/topic/food): Stories about cuisines, ingredients, traditions, and foodways.
- [Language](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/topic/language): Reporting on languages, linguistics, and endangered speech communities.
- [Traditions](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/topic/traditions): Features on rituals, celebrations, and cultural practices worldwide.
- [Arts](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/topic/arts): Coverage of visual arts, performance, and creative heritage.
- [Books](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/topic/books): Reading-related features, author interviews, and book recommendations.

## Photography & Video
- [Photography](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/photography): Main photography hub featuring galleries and visual storytelling.
- [Photo of the Day](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/photography/photo-of-the-day): Regularly featured photography selected from National Geographic imagery.
- [Your Shot](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/photography/your-shot): Community photography platform showcasing reader and contributor images.
- [Video](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/video): Documentary clips, short features, and visual reporting.
- [Magazine](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/magazine): Digital access to magazine stories, features, and issue content.

## Newsletters & Ways to Read
- [Newsletters](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/newsletters): Email newsletters covering major topics and editorial highlights.
- [Magazine](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/magazine): Current and archived magazine content from National Geographic.
- [Subscribe](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/subscribe): Subscription options for magazine access and related offers.
- [Digital Edition](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/magazine/digital-edition): Information about reading National Geographic in digital format.
- [Latest Stories](https://www.nationalgeographic.com/latest-stories): Broad entry point for current journalism across all sections.
